text:
aaron: Fyi i'm refreshing the hello-minimal quickstart to use the token refresh flow (instead of long-lived API keys) and adding a small self-hosted migration checklist. want a quick review on the snippets + CLI changes.

priya: 👍 which files are changing so i can update the Go SDK snippet?

aaron: quickstart/hello-minimal.md and a new docs/migrate-keys-selfhost.md. changes: env var name REDWOOD_REFRESH_TOKEN, example exchange flow, update deploy CLI to use catalog names (e.g. redwood/gpt-3.5-mini), and switch examples to use PORT fallback. also one auth link currently points to /docs/auth#apikey -> needs to go to /docs/auth#token-rotation.

jin: Sounds good. Can you call out Dedicated vs Hosted behavior for token rotation? i'll add a short note about enterprise key rotation policies.

aaron: will do. opened draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2490 (contains Go + curl + Python snippets, migration checklist, and link fixes).

docs-bot: Pull request opened by aaron: #2490 — linting OK, linkcheck found 2 bad anchors (fixed in branch).

priya: Pushing a Go snippet update now. prefer idiomatic context usage and error handling. sample i propose:
```go
ctx := context.Background()
refresh := os.Getenv("REDWOOD_REFRESH_TOKEN")
if refresh == "" {
    log.Fatal("missing REDWOOD_REFRESH_TOKEN")
}
tok, err := auth.ExchangeRefresh(ctx, refresh)
if err != nil {
    log.Fatalf("token exchange failed: %v", err)
}
client := redwood.NewClient(redwood.WithAccessToken(tok.AccessToken))
res, err := client.Generate(ctx, "Hello from Go")
if err != nil {
    log.Fatalf("generate error: %v", err)
}
fmt.Println(res.Text)
```

kate: can you add a minimal curl example showing the exchange + call? that helps ops folks.

aaron: added curl examples and a bash export example (`export REDWOOD_REFRESH_TOKEN=...`). also added a short security note: "store refresh tokens in a secret manager / KMS; rotate periodically; do not commit to repos."

jin: nit: examples should default to PORT env fallback `PORT || 8081` in JS/python containers. our container infra uses 8081 as default.

aaron: updated both the node express snippet and the gunicorn bind to use `process.env.PORT || 8081` / `bind = "0.0.0.0:${PORT:-8081}"`.

preview-bot: Staging preview for PR #2490 generated: https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/quickstart/hello-minimal — rendering OK, visual diffs: minor spacing.

priya: left a few small comments on naming (use `redwood/gpt-3.5-mini` catalog id).

aaron: fixed catalog naming, addressed spacing nits. re-requesting reviews.

docs-bot: PR #2490 merged by aaron — site rebuilt and published.

aaron: thanks all. i'll open a follow-up issue to add an automated migration script for self-hosted customers and a short checklist in the enterprise onboarding playbook: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/314

kate: thanks! this should make on-boarding much smoother for infra teams.
